value.rationale: The seven-cycle is the first longer odd-cycle source beyond the classical pentagon for four-colour graph-Hom complexes. Determining the actual finite cyclic fundamental group of its free source-rotation orbit space resolves a natural nonabelian homotopy invariant not determined by the classical original-space homology. The exact 14-torsion and cover group distinguish integral equivariant topology from rational cohomology, and the complete 2-skeleton group calculation is a meaningful finite classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; no all-odd-cycle statement is claimed.
